versions.changelog:
Voice Chat Bridge Skill 1.1.0 adds robust, flexible two-way voice assistant capabilities.

- Supports bi-directional voice interaction: speech-to-text transcription + Edge TTS natural speech synthesis.
- Multiple deployment options: local playback, web interface, Cloudflare Tunnel, Ngrok, and LocalTunnel for global access.
- Integrates with Telegram, Discord, Slack, webhook, and supports both command-line and GUI modes.
- Customizable voice, hotkey recording, language selection, and local/online recognition engine support.
- Quick setup guides and full conversational loop for hands-free, voice-first experiences.
